report.question: The repo is the source of truth and the live tree is a deploy target, but the two have diverged in BOTH directions - measured 28 content-differing rule files, 25 repo-larger and 3 live-larger. Question: does rolling back the deploy target destroy the live-only content, and does the rollback procedure detect two-directional divergence before it writes?
report.title: Rollback of the deploy target without destroying two-directional live drift
report.verdict: Naive one-directional rollback of the deploy target (copy repo over live) would destroy live-only content on 7 paths. The two-directional procedure detects that class before any write, flags both-unique files NEEDS-RECONCILE (never auto-resolved), classifies byte-identical files as NO-OP, and this unit executed dry-run only (writes_executed=0). Host live harness trees present_nonempty=1; table measured on today's fixture estate, not cited from 2026-08-09.
